string.ConfigDescription: Lightweight CRM: leads, pipelines and sources
string.Name: Name
string.ConvertLeadHint: A qualified lead becomes a requirement. The lead is converted at most once — repeating this opens the requirement that already exists.
string.ConvertReplayed: This lead has already been converted
string.ConvertInProgress: This lead is being converted right now. Please wait a moment and try again.
string.ConvertUnavailable: The conversion service did not answer. Nothing was changed.
string.ConvertErrored: The server could not complete the conversion. Reload and check the lead before trying again.
string.ReasonIllegalTransition: Only a lead in the Qualifying status can be converted. Move it to Qualifying first.
string.ReasonConvertedWithoutLink: The lead is marked Converted but has no link to a requirement. Ask an administrator to check it.
string.ReasonInvalidTraceLink: The traceability link between the lead and the requirement was rejected.
string.ReasonRequirementIdTaken: Another document already occupies the requirement identifier for this lead.
string.DisqualifyHint: A disqualified lead is closed for good. Say why — the reason is stored on the lead and is required by the server.
string.DisqualifyNotAllowed: This lead cannot be disqualified from its current status.
string.DisqualifyFailed: The server refused this change. Reload the lead and check its status before retrying.
string.RequiredFieldsComplete: Every required field is filled in.
string.RequiredFieldsMissing: These required fields are still empty:
string.ConvertedReadonly: This lead has been converted and is read only.
string.IntakeHint: Tell us who you are and what you need. Someone from our team will pick this up.
string.IntakeSubjectPlaceholder: e.g. Acme Corp - evaluating your platform
string.IntakeMessagePlaceholder: What are you looking for, and how soon do you need it?
string.IntakeThanks: Thank you. We have received your message.
string.IntakeTitleRequired: Please tell us who you are before sending.
string.IntakeFailed: We could not accept this submission. Please try again later.
